subject: Partner solution qualification: Clearsail integration engineering review
messages:
From: Alex Barton <alex@clearsail.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehra <priya@clearsail.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync — Redwood + Clearsail validation & next steps

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for taking a few minutes last week at the partner summit. We ran a lightproof-of-concept with a couple of our customers and would like to scope a joint technical validation leading to a reference integration. High level asks:

- Confirm Redwood runtime compatibility with our model packaging (ONNX + custom kernels)
- Exercise private deployment path (VPC) with our sample payloads and verify latency profile
- Agree on a mutual action plan and success criteria for a partner reference.

I've attached a short reference architecture and a spreadsheet with suggested milestones. Would you or someone on your integrations team be available for a 45–60min architecture review this week?

Best,

Alex Barton
Head of Integrations | Clearsail Analytics
alex@clearsail.ai | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: clearsail-proposed-reference-arch-v1.pdf (pdf), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barton <alex@clearsail.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Redwood + Clearsail validation & next steps

Alex —

Great to hear the early results and thanks for the artifacts. I'm looping in Sergio (runtime) and Marissa (partner ops) to run the technical kickoff. Quick answers up front: Redwood can accept ONNX-exported models but we'll want to validate kernel compatibility for the custom ops; we also support VPC/private deployment and can mirror your payloads in a short end-to-end smoke test.

Proposed next steps:
1) Architecture review meeting — Wed 2027-09-15 10:00am PT (45m). Sergio will lead the deep-dive.
2) We (Redwood) will provision a short-lived Dedicated environment for a two-week validation.
3) Mutual Action Plan — we'll start from your spreadsheet and propose measurable SLOs (latency P50/P95, token cost delta, functional parity).

Sergio/Marissa — please confirm availability and whether you want to run preliminary compatibility checks on the sample model before the live session.

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

On Tue, Sep 14, 2027 at 09:12 AM Alex Barton <alex@clearsail.ai> wrote:

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Quick sync — Redwood + Clearsail validation & next steps

Team,

I reviewed the Clearsail architecture PDF. A few immediate technical notes to discuss in the review:

- Custom ops: we need a list of custom kernels and example operators. If they are limited to a small set we can provide shim kernels; if they require JIT-compiled CUDA extensions we'll need build artifacts from their CI.
- Model format: ONNX is fine but we must validate dynamic axis shapes and batch semantics.
- KV cache behavior: Clearsail uses long-context streaming; let's confirm expected cache eviction policy and checkpointing.
- Private deploy: We'll provision a VPC-private Dedicated stack and run a controlled benchmark; quota/limits and certificate exchange will be handled by Marissa.

Action items for the prep call (me):
- Request: Clearsail to provide one representative model artifact (ONNX), a small test corpus (~100 requests) and one failing test case if available.
- I'll run a quick local conversion and a dry-run on our test harness prior to Wed meeting.

Jonas — can you bring the reference deployment runbook excerpts (networking ports, expected instance sizes) so we can align on what we provision?

Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Principal Runtime Engineer | Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: none in this email

Thanks — attaching the sample ONNX and a 100-request test payload. Also including a short log excerpt showing the custom op name 'cs_attn_v2' that we observed in runtime traces.

Notes:
- We can reproduce the failing case intermittently; logs attached. If you need a container with our full runtime, we can share a minimal Dockerfile (internal) but would prefer to keep the validation on your side to exercise Redwood's conversion path.
- Drive link with diagrams: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1aBCdEfGH/view

Looking forward to the Wed call.

Best,
Priya Mehra
Integration Lead | Clearsail Analytics
priya@clearsail.ai

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alex Barton <alex@clearsail.ai>, Priya Mehra <priya@clearsail.ai>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — Redwood + Clearsail validation & next steps

Thanks everyone — great session today. Quick recap and agreed mutual action plan items (summary for Ops and Sales):

1) Immediate validation tasks (Sergio/Redwood):
   - Run ONNX dry-conversion and confirm op compatibility by 2027-09-20.
   - Produce a compatibility matrix that lists unsupported ops and suggested workarounds.

2) Provisioning (Marissa/Jonas):
   - Stand up a 2-week Dedicated environment (VPC private) by 2027-09-22; load test harness and sample payloads.
   - Coordinate certificate exchange and network ACLs; Marissa will send the provisioning checklist.

3) Partner success criteria (joint):
   - Latency P50 < 120ms, P95 < 350ms for the sample 4k context workload; functional parity for outputs on the test corpus.
   - Produce a short technical note for a joint reference (marketing) if validation passes.

4) Timing and next checkpoint:
   - Initial results review: 2027-09-27 10:00am PT.

Marissa — please create the HubSpot engagement and upload the shared drive artifacts (HubSpot#HS-78492). Alex/Priya — thanks for sharing the model and logs; we'll reach out if we need the container.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Senior Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (spreadsheet)
